name: CLIENT_ID
label: OAuth client ID
setupSteps: Create and upload an OAuth app on HubSpot's project-based Developer Platform, not a legacy public app or private-app token.
For a managed proof of concept, set distribution to private and allowlist each account; use marketplace distribution later for broader installation.
Set the OAuth redirect URL to the exact URI below and require oauth plus contacts, companies, and deals read/write scopes.
Open the uploaded app's Auth settings, then copy its Client ID and Client secret here. The installing user must be a Super Admin or have App Marketplace Access.
